name: Pune e-Stock Broking Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2007, Pune E - Stock
Broking Ltd is in the business of Stock 
Broking, Pro Trading and depository 
services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) PESB is in the business to provide broking services and to do proprietary trading in derivative and cash market
b) Company has a Head Office in Pune & Branch offices in Ahmedabad & Delhi, with a presence in multiple cities through 120+ Authorised Persons
c) Company has a base of ~50,450+ 
 clients including 50,000+ clients in 
stock Broking and 450+ clients in
 mutual funds

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 12.2% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.8.50 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 359 days.
Working capital days have increased from -37.0 days to 78.9 days
